head: 8c040fca385dd8fffa0d7a13c45c53e79950bae1
authority: Ryan: move forward and be extremely thorough choosing our next step. Execute bounded saved-output CPU diagnosis; no new training, model inference, labels or protected evaluation.
question: Does previously unused response shape add candidate-localization ordering and visibility/absence separation beyond peak/native mass, without sacrificing valid weak or native-correct points?
feature_main_cohort: Every retained native-plus-strict-.01 candidate in all six complete HOU contexts; expected960 frames and10778 candidates; no cap or label-dependent sampling.
feature_stress_cohort: Every emitted or missing original expanded-weak choice in the same960 HOU frames; all rows retained, not just successful or below-.01 points. Exact old chosen coordinates and source audit retained.
feature_schema: One frame JSONL row with main_candidates descriptors and expanded_weak_selection descriptor; exact frame/PTS/timebase/meanhash/native selection/pool identity; labels absent from feature calculation.

descriptors.sampling: Bilinear float64 interpolation of bound float32 mean map, using inverse of frozen heatmap-to-source affine. No source-image or new-model features.
descriptors.support: Integer offsets[-10,10] in eachaxis; disk dx*dx+dy*dy<=100 (317samples); core<=25 (81), ring25<r2<=100 (236).
descriptors.orientation: Higher is favorable for every descriptor; no learned weights, chosen composite, threshold tuning or calibrated probability claim.
descriptors.isotropy: Smallest/largest eigenvalue of response-weighted source-offset covariance; zero spatial variance gives null for this descriptor only.
descriptors.negative_centroid_distance: Negative Euclidean distance of response-weighted centroid from emitted candidate center, in source pixels.
descriptors.negative_spread: Negative square root of covariance trace, in source pixels.
descriptors.missing_evidence: Incomplete source/map boundary patch, nonfinite input, all-zero support or missing chosen point stays explicitly unknown; never zero-filled or silently removed from denominators.
descriptors.baselines: Peak is the amplitude baseline. Original mass and component area remain metadata and can be ranked only within native candidates, never across extraction thresholds.
descriptors.not_independent_features: Descriptors share a response map and correlated shape information; agreement is not independent corroboration.

analysis.reference_roles: Existing frozen reference classification only; geometry-outside10 means localization mismatch, not a semantic non-ball label. Certain-hidden is negative emission evidence; uncertain/unscored frames stay separate.
analysis.within_frame: Per episode, report availability, number of geometric-outside10 competitors strictly above/tied with best matching candidate for each descriptor, with all feature-unknown counts. Native mass baseline restricted to native candidates.
visibility_bounds: Strict cutoff at maximum observed certain-hidden score: report best-case surviving matching-candidate coverage and retention of each original native-correct point.
Inclusive cutoff at minimum observed native-correct score: report certain-hidden rejection and retained selected-output gains.
analysis.bounds_are_diagnostic: Reference-assisted feasibility limits, not operational thresholds or fresh validation. Do not select a winner from this table or produce new trajectories.
analysis.stress: Report original expanded weak choices by old native correctness, missing gains, wrongs, certain/uncertain hidden and original extraction identity where available; explicitly retain e01 gains194-203 and e05 gains14-19 below.01.
analysis.counts: Per episode primary; pooled numbers descriptive. No frame independence, p-values, semantic label campaign or fitted classifier.

coverage.controls: Same-frame translated accepted-reference locations; drop and count out-of-source controls. These are local spatial-density controls, not semantic negatives or independent samples.
coverage.outputs: Per context actual/control coverage, paired frame average control coverage, nearest-distance summaries; original native-missing HOU and all19 DETgap frames separately.
coverage.DET_rule: Fixed diagnostic only after this protocol is locked; no DET feature/parameter/threshold selection or model fitting.

decision_rules.useful_increment: Consistent paired shape/contrast separation beyond amplitude/native mass, together with meaningful hidden rejection that protects native-correct and known weak gains, can justify one separately frozen evidence-conditioned scoring/abstention comparison. Final acceptance need not already pass.
decision_rules.adverse: If descriptors fail ordering, overlap on certain-hidden/valid points, or gain mainly by losing valid partial/weak balls, reject only these descriptor rules; do not conclude all postprocessing/appearance is exhausted.
decision_rules.next_information: An adverse result motivates a concrete native-pixel, point-conditioned representation feasibility design; no automatic generic DINO veto, crop inference or training.
decision_rules.density: High translated-location coverage limits how much identity evidence can be inferred from broad-pool oracle availability alone. It does not erase actual e01 recovery or prove absent ball signal.

preparation: Synthetic-only descriptor tests before freeze. Prior HOU labels/outcomes informed the hypothesis and cohorts; this is explicitly repeatedly inspected development. New descriptor results not examined before protocol freeze.
